evidence.title: Arbitrage-Aware Multi-Step Forecasting of Implied Volatility Surfaces: Modelling Surface Trajectories Using Latent Diffusion

summary: Researchers introduce an arbitrage-aware AI approach to predict implied volatility surfaces over multiple steps using latent diffusion models. The method aims to improve financial forecasting by capturing complex surface trajectories while ensuring no-arbitrage conditions.
title: New AI Model Uses Latent Diffusion for Multi-Step Implied Volatility Surface Forecasting
